topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Funny how a city can turn on you, one lie at a time. There I was, sipping my whiskey, mind on nothing in particular, when in walks a face I thought I knew. Turns out, the old pal, the one I used to think was solid, was painting a pretty picture of his life, all glitz and glamour, high-flying gigs. Only the gigs never existed. What a setup, huh? Thought I'd seen it all, but this, this is a new one. People and their stories, you just can't trust 'em, not even the ones who smile at you over the good old days. Gonna need to dig a little deeper, see what's really going on. But first, another drink, I reckon.
